name: Mahaprasthanika Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
evaM vRRiShNyandhakakule shrutvA mausalamAhavam |
pANDavAH kimakurvanta tathA kRRiShNe divaM gate
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvaiva kauravo rAjA vRRiShNInAM kadanaM mahat |
prasthAne matimAdhAya vAkyamarjunamabravIt
shlokas.3:
kAlaH pachati bhUtAni sarvANyeva mahAmate |
karmanyAsamahaM manye tvamapi draShTumarhasi
shlokas.4:
ityuktaH sa tu kaunteyaH kAlaH kAla iti bruvan |
anvapadyata tadvAkyaM bhrAturjyeShThasya vIryavAn
shlokas.5:
arjunasya mataM j~nAtvA bhImaseno yamau tathA |
anvapadyanta tadvAkyaM yaduktaM savyasAchinA
shlokas.6:
tato yuyutsumAnAyya pravrajandharmakAmyayA |
rAjyaM paridadau sarvaM vaishyAputre yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.7:
abhiShichya svarAjye tu taM rAjAnaM parikShitam |
duHkhArtashchAbravIdrAjA subhadrAM pANDavAgrajaH
shlokas.8:
eSha putrasya te putraH kururAjo bhaviShyati |
yadUnAM parisheShashcha vajro rAjA kRRitashcha ha
shlokas.9:
parikShiddhAstinapure shakraprasthe tu yAdavaH |
vajro rAjA tvayA rakShyo mA chAdharme manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.10:
ityuktvA dharmarAjaH sa vAsudevasya dhImataH |
mAtulasya cha vRRiddhasya rAmAdInAM tathaiva cha
shlokas.11:
mAtRRibhiH saha dharmAtmA kRRitvodakamatandritaH |
shrAddhAnyuddishya sarveShAM chakAra vidhivattadA
shlokas.12:
dadau ratnAni vAsA.nsi grAmAnashvAnrathAnapi |
striyashcha dvijamukhyebhyo gavAM shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.13:
kRRipamabhyarchya cha gurumarthamAnapuraskRRitam |
shiShyaM parikShitaM tasmai dadau bharatasattamaH
shlokas.14:
tatastu prakRRitIH sarvAH samAnAyya yudhiShThiraH |
sarvamAchaShTa rAjarShishchikIrShitamathAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
te shrutvaiva vachastasya paurajAnapadA janAH |
bhRRishamudvignamanaso nAbhyanandanta tadvachaH
shlokas.16:
naivaM kartavyamiti te tadochuste narAdhipam |
na cha rAjA tathAkArShItkAlaparyAyadharmavit
shlokas.17:
tato.anumAnya dharmAtmA paurajAnapadaM janam |
gamanAya matiM chakre bhrAtarashchAsya te tadA
shlokas.18:
tataH sa rAjA kauravyo dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
utsRRijyAbharaNAnya~NgAjjagRRihe valkalAnyuta
shlokas.19:
bhImArjunau yamau chaiva draupadI cha yashasvinI |
tathaiva sarve jagRRihurvalkalAni janAdhipa
shlokas.21:
tataH praruruduH sarvAH striyo dRRiShTvA nararShabhAn |
prasthitAndraupadIShaShThAnpurA dyUtajitAnyathA
shlokas.22:
harSho.abhavachcha sarveShAM bhrAtR^INAM gamanaM prati |
yudhiShThiramataM j~nAtvA vRRiShNikShayamavekShya cha
shlokas.23:
bhrAtaraH pa~ncha kRRiShNA cha ShaShThI shvA chaiva saptamaH |
AtmanA saptamo rAjA niryayau gajasAhvayAt
paurairanugato dUraM sarvairantaHpuraistathA
shlokas.24:
na chainamashakatkashchinnivartasveti bhAShitum |
nyavartanta tataH sarve narA nagaravAsinaH
shlokas.25:
kRRipaprabhRRitayashchaiva yuyutsuM paryavArayan |
vivesha ga~NgAM kauravya ulUpI bhujagAtmajA
shlokas.26:
chitrA~NgadA yayau chApi maNipUrapuraM prati |
shiShTAH parikShitaM tvanyA mAtaraH paryavArayan
shlokas.27:
pANDavAshcha mahAtmAno draupadI cha yashasvinI |
kRRitopavAsAH kauravya prayayuH prA~NmukhAstataH
shlokas.29:
yudhiShThiro yayAvagre bhImastu tadanantaram |
arjunastasya chAnveva yamau chaiva yathAkramam
shlokas.30:
pRRiShThatastu varArohA shyAmA padmadalekShaNA |
draupadI yoShitAM shreShThA yayau bharatasattama
shlokas.31:
shvA chaivAnuyayAvekaH pANDavAnprasthitAnvane |
krameNa te yayurvIrA lauhityaM salilArNavam
shlokas.32:
gANDIvaM cha dhanurdivyaM na mumocha dhana~njayaH |
ratnalobhAnmahArAja tau chAkShayyau maheShudhI
shlokas.33:
agniM te dadRRishustatra sthitaM shailamivAgrataH |
mArgamAvRRitya tiShThantaM sAkShAtpuruShavigraham
shlokas.34:
tato devaH sa saptArchiH pANDavAnidamabravIt |
bho bho pANDusutA vIrAH pAvakaM mAM vibodhata
shlokas.35:
yudhiShThira mahAbAho bhImasena parantapa |
arjunAshvisutau vIrau nibodhata vacho mama
shlokas.36:
ahamagniH kurushreShThA mayA dagdhaM cha khANDavam |
arjunasya prabhAveNa tathA nArAyaNasya cha
shlokas.37:
ayaM vaH phalguno bhrAtA gANDIvaM paramAyudham |
parityajya vanaM yAtu nAnenArtho.asti kashchana
shlokas.38:
chakraratnaM tu yatkRRiShNe sthitamAsInmahAtmani |
gataM tachcha punarhaste kAlenaiShyati tasya ha
shlokas.39:
varuNAdAhRRitaM pUrvaM mayaitatpArthakAraNAt |
gANDIvaM kArmukashreShThaM varuNAyaiva dIyatAm
shlokas.40:
tataste bhrAtaraH sarve dhana~njayamachodayan |
sa jale prAkShipattattu tathAkShayyau maheShudhI
shlokas.41:
tato.agnirbharatashreShTha tatraivAntaradhIyata |
yayushcha pANDavA vIrAstataste dakShiNAmukhAH
shlokas.42:
tataste tUttareNaiva tIreNa lavaNAmbhasaH |
jagmurbharatashArdUla dishaM dakShiNapashchimam
shlokas.43:
tataH punaH samAvRRittAH pashchimAM dishameva te |
dadRRishurdvArakAM chApi sAgareNa pariplutAm
shlokas.44:
udIchIM punarAvRRittya yayurbharatasattamAH |
prAdakShiNyaM chikIrShantaH pRRithivyA yogadharmiNaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste niyatAtmAna udIchIM dishamAsthitAH |
dadRRishuryogayuktAshcha himavantaM mahAgirim
shlokas.2:
taM chApyatikramantaste dadRRishurvAlukArNavam |
avaikShanta mahAshailaM meruM shikhariNAM varam
shlokas.3:
teShAM tu gachChatAM shIghraM sarveShAM yogadharmiNAm |
yAj~nasenI bhraShTayogA nipapAta mahItale
shlokas.4:
tAM tu prapatitAM dRRiShTvA bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
uvAcha dharmarAjAnaM yAj~nasenImavekShya ha
shlokas.5:
nAdharmashcharitaH kashchidrAjaputryA parantapa |
kAraNaM kiM nu tadrAjanyatkRRiShNA patitA bhuvi
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
pakShapAto mahAnasyA visheSheNa dhana~njaye |
tasyaitatphalamadyaiShA bhu~Nkte puruShasattama
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktvAnavekShyainAM yayau dharmasuto nRRipaH |
samAdhAya mano dhImAndharmAtmA puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.8:
sahadevastato dhImAnnipapAta mahItale |
taM chApi patitaM dRRiShTvA bhImo rAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.9:
yo.ayamasmAsu sarveShu shushrUShuranaha~NkRRitaH |
so.ayaM mAdravatIputraH kasmAnnipatito bhuvi
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
AtmanaH sadRRishaM prAj~naM naiSho.amanyata ka~nchana |
tena doSheNa patitastasmAdeSha nRRipAtmajaH
shlokas.11:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA tu samutsRRijya sahadevaM yayau tadA |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha kaunteyaH shunA chaiva yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.12:
kRRiShNAM nipatitAM dRRiShTvA sahadevaM cha pANDavam |
Arto bandhupriyaH shUro nakulo nipapAta ha
shlokas.13:
tasminnipatite vIre nakule chArudarshane |
punareva tadA bhImo rAjAnamidamabravIt
shlokas.14:
yo.ayamakShatadharmAtmA bhrAtA vachanakArakaH |
rUpeNApratimo loke nakulaH patito bhuvi
shlokas.15:
ityukto bhImasenena pratyuvAcha yudhiShThiraH |
nakulaM prati dharmAtmA sarvabuddhimatAM varaH
shlokas.16:
rUpeNa matsamo nAsti kashchidityasya darshanam |
adhikashchAhamevaika ityasya manasi sthitam
shlokas.17:
nakulaH patitastasmAdAgachCha tvaM vRRikodara |
yasya yadvihitaM vIra so.avashyaM tadupAshnute
shlokas.18:
tA.nstu prapatitAndRRiShTvA pANDavaH shvetavAhanaH |
papAta shokasantaptastato.anu paravIrahA
shlokas.19:
tasmi.nstu puruShavyAghre patite shakratejasi |
mriyamANe durAdharShe bhImo rAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.20:
anRRitaM na smarAmyasya svaireShvapi mahAtmanaH |
atha kasya vikAro.ayaM yenAyaM patito bhuvi
shlokas.21:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ekAhnA nirdaheyaM vai shatrUnityarjuno.abravIt |
na cha tatkRRitavAneSha shUramAnI tato.apatat
shlokas.22:
avamene dhanurgrAhAneSha sarvA.nshcha phalgunaH |
yathA choktaM tathA chaiva kartavyaM bhUtimichChatA
shlokas.23:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA prasthito rAjA bhImo.atha nipapAta ha |
patitashchAbravIdbhImo dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.24:
bho bho rAjannavekShasva patito.ahaM priyastava |
kiMnimittaM cha patanaM brUhi me yadi vettha ha
shlokas.25:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
atibhuktaM cha bhavatA prANena cha vikatthase |
anavekShya paraM pArtha tenAsi patitaH kShitau
shlokas.26:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA taM mahAbAhurjagAmAnavalokayan |
shvA tveko.anuyayau yaste bahushaH kIrtito mayA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH saMnAdaya~nshakro divaM bhUmiM cha sarvashaH |
rathenopayayau pArthamArohetyabravIchcha tam
shlokas.2:
sa bhrAtR^InpatitAndRRiShTvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
abravIchChokasantaptaH sahasrAkShamidaM vachaH
shlokas.3:
bhrAtaraH patitA me.atra AgachCheyurmayA saha |
na vinA bhrAtRRibhiH svargamichChe gantuM sureshvara
shlokas.4:
sukumArI sukhArhA cha rAjaputrI pura.ndara |
sAsmAbhiH saha gachCheta tadbhavAnanumanyatAm
shlokas.5:
indra uvAcha||
bhrAtR^IndrakShyasi putrA.nstvamagratastridivaM gatAn |
kRRiShNayA sahitAnsarvAnmA shucho bharatarShabha
shlokas.6:
nikShipya mAnuShaM dehaM gatAste bharatarShabha |
anena tvaM sharIreNa svargaM gantA na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ayaM shvA bhUtabhavyesha bhakto mAM nityameva ha |
sa gachCheta mayA sArdhamAnRRisha.nsyA hi me matiH
shlokas.8:
indra uvAcha||
amartyatvaM matsamatvaM cha rAja;~nshriyaM kRRitsnAM mahatIM chaiva kIrtim |
samprApto.adya svargasukhAni cha tvaM; tyaja shvAnaM nAtra nRRisha.nsamasti
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
anAryamAryeNa sahasranetra; shakyaM kartuM duShkarametadArya |
mA me shriyA sa~NgamanaM tayAstu; yasyAH kRRite bhaktajanaM tyajeyam
shlokas.10:
indra uvAcha||
svarge loke shvavatAM nAsti dhiShNya;miShTApUrtaM krodhavashA haranti |
tato vichArya kriyatAM dharmarAja; tyaja shvAnaM nAtra nRRisha.nsamasti
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhaktatyAgaM prAhuratyantapApaM; tulyaM loke brahmavadhyAkRRitena |
tasmAnnAhaM jAtu katha~nchanAdya; tyakShyAmyenaM svasukhArthI mahendra
shlokas.12:
indra uvAcha||
shunA dRRiShTaM krodhavashA haranti; yaddattamiShTaM vivRRitamatho hutaM cha |
tasmAchChunastyAgamimaM kuruShva; shunastyAgAtprApsyase devalokam
shlokas.13:
tyaktvA bhrAtR^IndayitAM chApi kRRiShNAM; prApto lokaH karmaNA svena vIra |
shvAnaM chainaM na tyajase kathaM nu; tyAgaM kRRitsnaM chAsthito muhyase.adya
shlokas.14:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na vidyate sandhirathApi vigraho; mRRitairmartyairiti lokeShu niShThA |
na te mayA jIvayituM hi shakyA; tasmAttyAgasteShu kRRito na jIvatAm
shlokas.15:
pratipradAnaM sharaNAgatasya; striyA vadho brAhmaNasvApahAraH |
mitradrohastAni chatvAri shakra; bhaktatyAgashchaiva samo mato me
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taddharmarAjasya vacho nishamya; dharmasvarUpI bhagavAnuvAcha |
yudhiShThiraM prItiyukto narendraM; shlakShNairvAkyaiH sa.nstavasamprayuktaiH
shlokas.17:
abhijAto.asi rAjendra piturvRRittena medhayA |
anukroshena chAnena sarvabhUteShu bhArata
shlokas.18:
purA dvaitavane chAsi mayA putra parIkShitaH |
pAnIyArthe parAkrAntA yatra te bhrAtaro hatAH
shlokas.19:
bhImArjunau parityajya yatra tvaM bhrAtarAvubhau |
mAtroH sAmyamabhIpsanvai nakulaM jIvamichChasi
shlokas.20:
ayaM shvA bhakta ityeva tyakto devarathastvayA |
tasmAtsvarge na te tulyaH kashchidasti narAdhipa
shlokas.21:
atastavAkShayA lokAH svasharIreNa bhArata |
prApto.asi bharatashreShTha divyAM gatimanuttamAm
shlokas.22:
tato dharmashcha shakrashcha marutashchAshvinAvapi |
devA devarShayashchaiva rathamAropya pANDavam
shlokas.23:
prayayuH svairvimAnaiste siddhAH kAmavihAriNaH |
sarve virajasaH puNyAH puNyavAgbuddhikarmiNaH
shlokas.24:
sa taM rathaM samAsthAya rAjA kurukulodvahaH |
UrdhvamAchakrame shIghraM tejasAvRRitya rodasI
shlokas.25:
tato devanikAyastho nAradaH sarvalokavit |
uvAchochchaistadA vAkyaM bRRihadvAdI bRRihattapAH
shlokas.26:
ye.api rAjarShayaH sarve te chApi samupasthitAH |
kIrtiM prachChAdya teShAM vai kururAjo.adhitiShThati
shlokas.27:
lokAnAvRRitya yashasA tejasA vRRittasampadA |
svasharIreNa samprAptaM nAnyaM shushruma pANDavAt
shlokas.28:
nAradasya vachaH shrutvA rAjA vachanamabravIt |
devAnAmantrya dharmAtmA svapakShA.nshchaiva pArthivAn
shlokas.29:
shubhaM vA yadi vA pApaM bhrAtR^INAM sthAnamadya me |
tadeva prAptumichChAmi lokAnanyAnna kAmaye
shlokas.30:
rAj~nastu vachanaM shrutvA devarAjaH pura.ndaraH |
AnRRisha.nsyasamAyuktaM pratyuvAcha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.31:
sthAne.asminvasa rAjendra karmabhirnirjite shubhaiH |
kiM tvaM mAnuShyakaM snehamadyApi parikarShasi
shlokas.32:
siddhiM prApto.asi paramAM yathA nAnyaH pumAnkvachit |
naiva te bhrAtaraH sthAnaM samprAptAH kurunandana
shlokas.33:
adyApi mAnuSho bhAvaH spRRishate tvAM narAdhipa |
svargo.ayaM pashya devarShInsiddhA.nshcha tridivAlayAn
shlokas.35:
tairvinA notsahe vastumiha daityanibarhaNa |
gantumichChAmi tatrAhaM yatra me bhrAtaro gatAH
shlokas.36:
yatra sA bRRihatI shyAmA buddhisattvaguNAnvitA |
draupadI yoShitAM shreShThA yatra chaiva priyA mama
